record.title: Evaluate stock post-store evidence and select a bounded coverage or initialization continuation
record.intent: Follow the next witnessed dependency after resolving observer correctness.
requirements: Separate observed stock state, synthetic inputs and untraced-thread uncertainty.
Require explicit thread coverage evaluation before admitting additional modeled responses.
acceptance: Select one bounded continuation justified by the actual capture, including a negative gate when appropriate.
Commit and push conclusions before another experiment.
